retraining_policy: none in this release; future changes require new reviewed model release

output.uncertainty: independent validation residual calibration, no conditional coverage guarantee

environment.platform_tested: macOS arm64; other platforms must rerun selftest
native_libraries: OpenMP runtime required by LightGBM; macOS libomp / Linux compatible libgomp
environment.compatibility: exact versions checked before deserialization; no silent downgrade

runtime.requirement_basis: conservative starting budget; measured process RSS stored in SELFTEST_RESULT.json; verify on target host
runtime.concurrency: one loaded model per worker recommended; keep thread budget within available cores

security.joblib: pickle deserialization can execute code; trusted manifest/root required
security.integrity: SHA256 before joblib.load; tampering with both file and manifest cannot be detected without an independently trusted manifest digest
